title: The Fort Valley State Wildcats matchups are set for upcoming college basketball season - Warner Robins Today
text:
The Fort Valley State Wildcats now know who they’ll face on the court in the 2025-2026 college basketball season.
The Wildcats kick off the season at home against the Rollins Tars on Nov. 15 at Health and Physical Education Complex.
The Wildcats end their season away against the LeMoyne-Owen Magicians on Feb. 21 at Bruce-Johnson Hall.
They play a total of 26 games this year in the regular season with 14 of those games at home and 12 away or at neutral sites.
Some games may change due to unforeseen mid-season circumstances.
